How to get the same physical-board state as Anders (nothing below is on main yet):
1) Firmware: the board runs Leo's office_station (project.yaml with the verified port map in feat/atech-device-bridge / feat/pydantic-agent-backend 195cea1). On a new laptop you don't need to reflash; it stays on the board.
2) Backend + dashboard: main 0740237 + feat/smarter-grocery-defaults (f715ccc: groceries propose sensible defaults instead of asking about package size). npm ci && npm run setup:python && cp .env.example .env && npm run dev. Connect Oda via http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/integrations/oda/connect (NOT :5173). OFFICE_MODEL=mock unless you have ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
3) Station: branch air-quality-stt (c9d1fbd) apps/speech/voice_station.py: uv venv --python 3.12 apps/speech/.venv && uv pip install --python apps/speech/.venv/bin/python -r apps/speech/requirements.txt atech pyserial; put ELEVENLABS_API_KEY in that checkout's .env; run apps/speech/.venv/bin/python apps/speech/voice_station.py --port $(ls /dev/cu.usbmodem*) --api http://127.0.0.1:3001
4) Only ONE process may hold the board's USB (stop the bridge, atech monitor and test scripts). The screen shows "Trykk paa knappen og snakk" with a blue LED when ready.
Noah (procurement owner): please review feat/smarter-grocery-defaults; tests pass (29 procurement, 155 agent).
